clue.text: Rome's source for investors looking for a return

definitions.text: Rome's source for investors looking for a return

parts.words: Rome's source for investors looking for a return
parts.note: a famous Roman water feature into which tourists toss coins, an investment said to secure their return to the city

explanation.surface: A financial tip about where in Rome investors might find a good return.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Investors' and 'return' sound financial, but the investors are tourists tossing coins, and the return is a promised trip back to Rome.
explanation.definitionFit: Legend says a coin thrown into this Baroque Roman fountain guarantees the thrower will come back to Rome.

clue.text: Not a well-cooked portion of savoury

parts.note: meat that is not well cooked is rare
a portion is a bit

explanation.surface: A complaint about an undercooked serving of something savoury.
explanation.walkthrough: A RAREBIT (Welsh rarebit) is a British dish of cheese sauce on toast, often served as a savoury at the end of a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: Welsh rarebit is a classic savoury, the cheesy toast course of a traditional British dinner.

clue.text: It is seen as an opinion

definitions.meaning: a vista or scene is what is seen from a place
a personal judgement or point of ... on a matter

explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a sight or prospect and a held opinion, as in 'in my view'.

clue.text: Tiredness may lead to failure under stress

definitions.meaning: the engineering sense: metal weakening and cracking after repeated stress

explanation.definitionFit: The word means exhaustion, and in engineering the weakening of metal that leads to structural failure under repeated loads.

clue.text: All the same, a soldier has to assume it

definitions.text: a soldier has to assume it
definitions.meaning: a soldier must put on regulation dress

explanation.definitionFit: As an adjective it means identical throughout; as a noun it is the regulation outfit a soldier puts on.

clue.text: What sea may do to ship

parts.note: taken as written
SS is the abbreviation for steamship

explanation.surface: A description of rough waves battering a vessel.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue reads as one definition, but 'to ship' is the wordplay.
explanation.definitionFit: Rough seas throw a boat about, the verb for being flung by waves.

clue.text: Conclude there's no place for the damned

parts.note: to conclude from evidence is to infer
taken as written

explanation.surface: A grim conclusion that there is no room left for the damned.
explanation.walkthrough: 'There's no place' reads as a single statement, but NO is simply a piece of the answer and 'place for the damned' is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian word for hell, made familiar by Dante's poem describing the realm of the damned.

clue.text: Fewer calls are made to have this reduced

definitions.text: Fewer calls are made to have this reduced

parts.words: Fewer calls are made to have this reduced
parts.note: a household cuts down on phoning in order to lower the charges it receives each quarter

explanation.definitionFit: The amount owed for phone use falls when fewer calls are made, so this charge is what economising reduces.

clue.text: Trial marriage?

parts.note: a 'match' can be a marriage, but here it is a game played as a trial run before the real contest

explanation.definitionFit: A warm-up game played for training is a trial match, punning on match meaning a marriage.

clue.text: Are moving home, it must be serious

indicators.note: letters that are moving are shifted into a new order

parts.note: a bird's home is its nest

explanation.surface: Moving house is presented as a serious business.
explanation.walkthrough: 'moving' rearranges ARE. 'Moving home' reads as one phrase about relocating, but the two words belong to separate pieces.
explanation.definitionFit: Earnest is a direct synonym for serious, sincere and solemn in intent.

clue.text: To some extent it's of Iran's making

indicators.note: the letters are being made into something new, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A remark about how far something is of Iranian manufacture.
explanation.walkthrough: 'making' rearranges the seven letters of OF IRANS; the 's is a letter here.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means to the degree that, limiting a statement to some extent.

clue.text: Ready to return to place of exile

indicators.note: to return is to go back, so the word is read from end to start

parts.note: ready and able, as in willing and capable

explanation.surface: Someone prepared to go back to the place they were banished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to return' turns ABLE round. ELBA is the Mediterranean island to which Napoleon was exiled in 1814.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon was banished to this Mediterranean island before escaping for the Hundred Days.

clue.text: I note and see love in the home

parts.note: G is a musical note
lo is an archaic word meaning look or see
love is zero in tennis, shown as O

explanation.surface: Someone notes and witnesses love inside a household.
explanation.walkthrough: 'see' is the old exclamation LO, as in 'lo and behold'.
explanation.definitionFit: An igloo is the domed snow house traditionally used as a home by Inuit people.

clue.text: Odile leaves a large creature for a shorter version

indicators.note: the name departs from the word, so those letters are taken away

parts.note: a crocodile is a large reptile
taken as written: a woman's name

explanation.surface: Odile walks away from a big animal in favour of a smaller one.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leaves' removes the run ODILE from the end of CROCODILE.
explanation.definitionFit: Croc is the clipped informal form of crocodile, a shortening of the full word.

clue.text: Flog what might be silver

definitions.meaning: to beat with a cane or bundle of twigs
a type of tree with silvery bark, as in the silver variety

explanation.definitionFit: To flog with twigs is to give a beating; the silver variety is a common tree with white bark.

clue.text: Tour right round a south-western city

indicators.note: the letters are turned round into a new arrangement

explanation.surface: A tour heading round the right way to a West Country city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'round' scrambles TOUR plus R. TRURO is the cathedral city of Cornwall, England's south-western tip.
explanation.definitionFit: Truro is the only city in Cornwall, in the far south-west of England.

clue.text: For use in emergency, it's a best seller

definitions.meaning: a direct phone link kept for crises
a line of goods selling fast

explanation.definitionFit: It names a direct emergency phone link, and in shop talk a product line that is selling very well.

clue.text: Of Romanic origin, he was involved in early radio

definitions.text: he was involved in early radio

indicators.note: 'of Romanic origin' says the name is made from those letters, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A biographical note on a radio pioneer of Latin descent.
explanation.walkthrough: Guglielmo MARCONI was the Italian inventor who pioneered long-distance radio transmission.
explanation.definitionFit: The Italian engineer Marconi sent the first transatlantic radio signals and shared a Nobel Prize for wireless telegraphy.

clue.text: Marks the broken section

indicators.note: something broken is in pieces, so the letters are reassembled differently

explanation.surface: A remark about a damaged portion of something.
explanation.definitionFit: To mark something is to observe or pay heed to it, as in 'mark my words'.

clue.text: Vessel churning up water left and right

indicators.note: water churned up is stirred around, so its letters are mixed

explanation.surface: A boat stirring up the sea on both sides.
explanation.walkthrough: 'churning up' mixes WATER with L and R together.
explanation.definitionFit: A trawler is a fishing boat that drags a net, a type of vessel.

clue.text: An expression of disbelief

parts.note: a retort meaning 'that's what you claim, but I don't believe it'

explanation.definitionFit: This retort is a colloquial way of saying one doubts what someone has just claimed.

clue.text: Listener's complaint

parts.note: a listener is literally an ear, and a complaint is an ailment, not a grumble

explanation.definitionFit: A pain in the ear is the ailment of the organ we listen with.

clue.text: Model, formerly fat?

parts.note: ex- means former
ample means plump or well-rounded

explanation.surface: A fashion model who used to be overweight.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Model' looks like a catwalk figure but means a pattern or specimen to follow.
explanation.definitionFit: A model is something held up as a pattern to copy, an exemplary instance.

clue.text: Author to mark with a tick, say

indicators.note: say signals that the phrase is spoken and matched by its sound

parts.note: to check off is to tick an item on a list

explanation.surface: A writer marking papers with ticks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'say' tells you CHECK OFF is heard, not written. Anton CHEKHOV was the Russian playwright and short story writer.
explanation.definitionFit: Anton Chekhov wrote plays such as The Cherry Orchard and many celebrated short stories.

clue.text: Worst — and best!

definitions.meaning: as a verb, to worst is to defeat
as a verb, to best someone is to outdo them

explanation.definitionFit: As verbs, worst and best both mean to defeat, which is what beat means.

clue.text: How government works as a rule

definitions.meaning: governing proceeds through legislation, by means of law
a local regulation made by a council or company

explanation.definitionFit: Read as two words it is how a state governs; as one, a local regulation.

clue.text: Nominally she gets five years

parts.note: V is the Roman numeral for five
an era is a long period of years

explanation.surface: A woman gets a five-year prison sentence, at least in name.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Nominally she' means a woman's name: here Vera.
explanation.definitionFit: Vera is a woman's first name, so by name it denotes a she.

clue.text: Lady in a senile and repetitive state?

definitions.text: in a senile and repetitive state?
definitions.meaning: doddering and confused, with a word that itself repeats a syllable

explanation.definitionFit: Lady Gaga is the singer; gaga means senile, and the word repeats its syllable.

clue.text: Disastrous sound — one changes colour

indicators.note: sound tells us the word is heard rather than spelt

parts.note: dire means dreadful or disastrous

explanation.surface: A dreadful noise from someone whose face changes colour.
explanation.walkthrough: 'sound' turns DIRE into a word said the same but spelt differently.
explanation.definitionFit: A dyer is a person whose trade is dyeing cloth, changing its colour.

clue.text: A noted soporific

parts.note: 'noted' means set to musical notes, not famous: a song that sends one to sleep

explanation.definitionFit: A lullaby is a gentle song sung to put a child to sleep, a sleep-inducer in music.

clue.text: Possibly spy on fashionable medium

indicators.note: possibly signals that the letters could be arranged another way

parts.note: chic means stylish or fashionable

explanation.surface: A spy keeping watch on a trendy clairvoyant.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Possibly' rearranges SPY. 'Medium' looks like a size, but it is a spiritualist.
explanation.definitionFit: A medium claims to contact spirits, which is a kind of psychic.

clue.text: Traverse route gathering valuable discoveries

indicators.note: the letters are gathered up and reassembled in a new order

explanation.surface: Crossing a route while picking up precious finds along the way.
explanation.walkthrough: 'gathering' reads as the route collecting finds, but it rearranges all thirteen letters of TRAVERSE ROUTE.
explanation.definitionFit: A treasure trove is a hoard of valuable things discovered hidden.
